title: The Pilgrims' Feast
text: It is a feast day in the shrine town. Tables run the length of the street, loaded with bread, roast meat and dark wine, and the pilgrims share with anyone who has walked the road. Their feet are bandaged, their smiles fixed and bright.

options.label: Sit and eat with the pilgrims, resting your feet among the faithful.

outcomes.text: You eat your fill among friends. By the end, their fixed smiles hardly seem strange.

options.label: Trade at the feast-day market while the town is in a generous mood.

outcomes.text: The prices are good and the wares better. Nobody asks where you have been.

options.label: The devout leads the feast in prayer, so the town remembers which House gave thanks.

outcomes.text: The town remembers your House, and says so loudly.
